title: Ending a South Australian tenancy
description: Steps for ending a tenancy after the 2024 and 2025 reforms. Summarised from Consumer and Business Services and SA.GOV.AU guidance.

sources.title: Tenancy reforms for landlords and agents
Forms and fact sheets for private rental tenancies

items.title: Confirm you have a prescribed reason to end or not renew the tenancy
To end a fixed term at its end, give 60 days' notice on the SA Form 9 notice of termination at end of fixed term
For a periodic tenancy, use the SA Form 7 notice of termination (possession required) or the SA Form 8 notice of termination on specified ground
For a breach, use the SA Form 5 landlord's notice of breach
Expect that the tenant may leave early on 7 days' notice
Inspect with the SA inspection sheet from the start of the tenancy
Agree the bond refund and process it through SA Residential Bonds Online
Keep any goods left behind safe for 7 days
Don't re-let the home within 6 months of your notice unless SACAT allows it
Keep the tenant's records for 3 years after the tenancy ends, securely
